name: USB-C to USB 3.0 OTG Adapter with Hanging Rope (Red)
shortDescription: Connect USB drives, keyboards and mice to your USB-C phone.
description: A compact USB-C male to USB-A female OTG adapter with a lanyard so it never gets lost. Plug USB flash drives, keyboards or mice straight into your phone, tablet or laptop.
highlights: Connect flash drives, keyboards and mice
